title: docs(skills): the project-setup guide stops mounting app-shell's ObjectView with an objectName prop it never had (objectui#11011)
body:
Fixes #11011
Clause-②: no

The published objectui skill's project-setup guide (`skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md`, section "`@object-ui/app-shell` — minimal shell + renderers") taught an `ObjectView` mounted with a single prop, `objectName="contact"`, and nothing else. The component has no `objectName` prop: it reads the route's `:objectName` with `useParams` from `react-router-dom` and resolves it against the required `objects` list, so a verbatim copy threw on first render, and since `ConsoleObjectViewProps` was declared (PR objectui#11010) the same mount fails to compile. The guide now keeps the provider + `AppShell` composition, names the four `ConsoleObjectViewProps` members, says the shell runs under React Router, and points at the README's "ObjectView" block — the one copy `pnpm check:doc-snippets` compiles — instead of restating it. Per triage's direction: pointing, not restating, keeps one copy under a gate; no new gate.

Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01KTZmMfzVzjNvyaLyQ8mHvg` (domain:skills seat 1, round 11, dispatched dev).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么。** `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` 的 `@object-ui/app-shell` 一节:删掉示例里那行把 `ObjectView` 当成接受 `objectName` 属性的挂载(该组件从没有这个属性),示例保留 provider 与 `AppShell` 的组合、把子节点位置改成一条 JSX 注释指向路由;把紧随其后的「App-shell 与路由无关」一句改成真话:`react-router-dom` 是 app-shell 的 peerDependency,`ObjectView` 从路由解析对象与视图,它的属性是导出的 `ConsoleObjectViewProps`(`dataSource`、`objects`、`onEdit`、可选 `externalRefreshKey`),正确挂载去读 app-shell README 的「ObjectView」小节。另加一个空 frontmatter changeset(不发版)。

**为什么改。** 这份 skill 是 AI 搭 objectui 项目时读的第一份材料,照抄那个挂载在 `main` 上首渲染即抛错、在 PR objectui#11010 之后直接编译失败;「与路由无关」那句也是假的(peerDependency 与 `useParams` 两处实测)。triage 的方向是「指向 README 里被 `check:doc-snippets` 编译的那一份,不要再抄一份」,本 PR 照做,且不新增门禁(新增门禁默认否)。

**风险与代价(含回滚)。** 只动一份 markdown 与一个空 changeset,不发版、不动代码。风险是文字仍有不准处——每个属性名、peerDependency、路由形状都在本树实测(见下方「前提核验」)。回滚:revert 这一个 squash commit 即可,无状态残留。

**席位意见。** (留空,席位定稿)

**你要做的。** `skills/**` 是受管面:本 PR 停在 draft。若认可,留下一条 APPROVED review(`os-zhuang` / `hotlong`),之后由派发席翻 ready 并入合并队列;不认可则在评论里说要改什么。

## Premise check at my tree (`caa0cd3`, objectui `origin/main` at cut; dispatch read `b28bde8`)

1. The wrong mount was still there: the section's fence imported `ObjectView` and mounted it with only `objectName="contact"`; the sentence after the fence called app-shell router-agnostic. Both read at `caa0cd3`.
2. `ConsoleObjectViewProps` (exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`, declared in `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`) has exactly `dataSource` (required), `objects` (required), `onEdit` (required), `externalRefreshKey` (optional); no `objectName`. `ObjectView` calls `useParams()` from `react-router-dom` and does `objects.find(...)` on the route's `objectName`; `react-router-dom` is a `peerDependencies` entry of `packages/app-shell/package.json`. The console mounts it as `Route path=":objectName"` with the four props (`packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`).
3. `check:doc-snippets` roots are `content/docs`, app docs, every `packages/**/README.md` and the root README — not `skills/**`. The README's "ObjectView" block carries no fragment marker between its heading and the next, so the opt-out gate compiles it; the pointer lands on a gated copy.
4. The guide's five `os:check` markers sit on earlier fences; the app-shell `tsx` fence was and stays unmarked, so `check:skill-examples` judges nothing I changed (both its legs still ran, below). ⚠️ The dispatch's mechanism assumption that `check:skill-eval-tokens` "meters the file" with a ceiling is **falsified**: that gate is an eval `must_contain` token oracle (bundle-wide), not a size meter; objectui has no skills line/token ratchet at all (no `scripts/*.mjs` header names one). Readings are reported anyway, below.
5. `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on both changed paths: exit 3, GOVERNED (`skills/**`); this PR is draft-only until an authorized APPROVED review.

## Before / after of the section

Angle brackets are written as ‹ › below because GitHub strips tag-shaped text from a PR body; the committed file has ordinary JSX.

Before:

```text
import { AppShell, ObjectView, AdapterProvider, MetadataProvider } from '@object-ui/app-shell';

‹AdapterProvider adapter={myAdapter}›
  ‹MetadataProvider adapter={myAdapter}›
    ‹AppShell sidebar={‹MySidebar /›}›
      ‹ObjectView objectName="contact" /›
    ‹/AppShell›
  ‹/MetadataProvider›
‹/AdapterProvider›

App-shell is router-agnostic — wire it into React Router / Next.js / TanStack Router yourself.
```

After:

```text
import { AppShell, AdapterProvider, MetadataProvider } from '@object-ui/app-shell';

‹AdapterProvider adapter={myAdapter}›
  ‹MetadataProvider adapter={myAdapter}›
    ‹AppShell sidebar={‹MySidebar /›}›
      {/* your React Router routes — ObjectView mounts on an object route, see below */}
    ‹/AppShell›
  ‹/MetadataProvider›
‹/AdapterProvider›

App-shell runs under React Router: `react-router-dom` is its peer dependency, and
`ObjectView` resolves the object and view from the route (the console mounts it on
`/apps/:appName/:objectName` and `/apps/:appName/:objectName/view/:viewId`), so it
takes no `objectName` prop. Its props are the exported `ConsoleObjectViewProps` —
`dataSource`, `objects`, `onEdit`, and the optional `externalRefreshKey`. Copy the
mount from the "ObjectView" section of `packages/app-shell/README.md`: that block is
the one `pnpm check:doc-snippets` compiles, and this guide does not restate it.
```

`AdapterProvider adapter`, `MetadataProvider adapter` and `AppShell sidebar` were checked against their providers' prop interfaces and kept.
